scoring_justification: DFT raw elastic constants, tensile strength, and Curie temperature cannot be recomputed from lightweight artifacts; derived polycrystalline moduli can be recomputed from the agent's elastic constants for cross-validation.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for elastic constants, polycrystalline moduli, debye temperature, ideal tensile strength, and Curie temperature
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from paper: C11/C12/C44 consistent with reported B/G (Table 1) and Fig.3; poly moduli from Table 1; Debye temperature 542 K and sound velocities from Fig.4; ideal tensile strength 7.7 GPa, 9% from Fig.5; Curie temperature 463 K from Fig.2.
hidden_assets.generation_method: The elastic constants for x=1.0 were back-calculated to exactly reproduce the paper's B=157.7 GPa and G=97.8 GPa; the reference solves solves them. The other gold values are directly the paper's reported numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Every number is the paper's own result for the specified composition, traceable to the tables/figures; no synthetic or arbitrary values.

outputs.description: Single-crystal elastic constants for x=0.6 and 1.0. Columns: composition (float), C11 (GPa), C12 (GPa), C44 (GPa).
Polycrystalline moduli and derived ratios for x=1.0. B, G, E in GPa; v, A_Z, B_over_G dimensionless.
Sound velocities and Debye temperature for x=1.0. theta_D in K; velocities in m/s.
Ideal tensile strength for x=1.0 under [001] tension. sigma_max in GPa, epsilon_max as fraction.
Curie temperature for x=1.0 in K.

output_contract.notes: The polycrystalline_moduli.csv column naming includes 'B_over_G' for the Pugh ratio. All numeric comparisons will be performed with hidden tolerances appropriate for DFT reproducibility.

gold._comment: gold values for each composition; tolerances in tolerances dict
